boons.name: Banked Coals
boons.text: Burn lasts half again as long on foes, and so do burning oil and your burning ground
boons.text2: Burn, burning oil and your burning ground last twice as long
boons.lore: The sextons banked the chapel's coals under ash each night, so no fire in the vault ever had to be lit twice.

boons.name: Flamekeeper
boons.text: In a fight, each flame within 2.5 tiles gives you 1 mana a second, up to four: lit braziers and candle stands, burning oil, your burning ground
boons.text2: Each flame within 3.5 tiles gives you 2 mana a second in a fight, up to four
boons.lore: A lamplighter learns to warm their hands at every flame they pass. The vault's braziers remember who tended them.

boons.name: Deep Winter
boons.text: Foes freeze at 2 Chill stacks instead of 3 (never a boss)
boons.text2: Foes freeze at 2 Chill stacks, and a freeze holds half again as long
boons.lore: In the coldest winters the crypt's water froze before the pilgrims could kneel to it, and the dead slept sounder.

boons.name: Cold Snap
boons.text: A frozen foe that thaws breathes a Chill stack onto every foe within 1.5 tiles
boons.text2: A frozen foe that thaws breathes 2 Chill stacks onto every foe within 2.2 tiles
boons.lore: What the ice lets go of, it breathes out again. The mausoleum keepers walked in pairs, so one could thaw the other.

boons.name: Forking Arc
boons.text: Arc leaps to two more foes, and a shock's leap reaches two foes instead of one
boons.text2: Arc leaps to four more foes, and a shock's leap reaches three
boons.lore: The bell-ringers said lightning never strikes the same tower twice. It strikes every tower near it instead.

boons.name: Spark Wake
boons.text: A foe your shock stuns leaves a spark on the floor for 3 seconds that stings foes, never you
boons.text2: Its spark lasts 5 seconds and stings harder
boons.lore: Storms that pass through the vault leave the flagstones humming for a while after, as if the stone still listened.

boons.name: Votive Heart
boons.text: One more heart container; the first Hallow spell you cast in a fight mends half a heart if you are hurt
boons.lore: Pilgrims left wax hearts at the chapel's altar, one for each prayer. The Wardens melted them down for candles, and the prayers burned too.

boons.name: Laid Bare
boons.text: A sanctified foe's guard is gone while it lasts: shells, lids, stone and plates take full blows
boons.text2: And Sanctified holds half again as long
boons.lore: Holy light lays everything open: the sexton's ledgers, the reliquary's seals, and the shells of things that hide.

boons.name: Thirsting Hex
boons.text: A hex drains life too: every 6 hex stacks your blows spend mend half a heart
boons.text2: Every 4 hex stacks spent mend half a heart
boons.lore: The embalmers knew a hex takes more than mana. What it takes has to go somewhere, and it may as well go to you.

boons.name: Gathering Dark
boons.text: Hex holds 7 stacks instead of 5 and fades a third slower
boons.text2: Hex holds 9 stacks and fades two thirds slower
boons.lore: In the lowest crypts the dark does not lift; it only settles, layer on layer, like dust no one sweeps.

boons.name: Seedfall
boons.text: An overgrown foe that falls leaves a flowering plant where it fell
boons.text2: Its plant bursts by itself a moment later, overgrowing the foes near it
boons.lore: Nothing buried stays only buried. Where the vines held something as it died, they leave a flower to mark the place.

boons.name: Perennial
boons.text: Overgrown holds half again as long, and a foe held at its full slow is rooted a moment
boons.text2: Overgrown holds twice as long, and roots a full second
boons.lore: The crypt's ivy outlived the sextons who cut it back. Given a season, it would outlive the walls as well.

boons.name: Tempered
boons.text: Three more points to spend on your attributes
boons.lore: Some apprentices learn a new spell from every page. Others learn the same lesson three times, and keep it.

boons.name: Second Socket
boons.text: A spell you choose gets a second rune socket, carved at the next waystone
boons.lore: The Wardens' best spells were carved twice over, rune within rune, so that one could hold if the other cracked.

boons.name: Keen Nose
boons.text: Potions are known on sight: on the floor, in the shop and in the Wandering Merchant's packs
boons.lore: Every potion smells of what made it: moss, ash, wax, the grave. A careful nose needs no spoon.

boons.name: Scavenger
boons.text: A foe put to rest by its weakness always leaves its reagent
boons.lore: Struck in the right place, a thing gives up what it is made of. The embalmers called it a clean harvest.

boons.name: Brewer's Breath
boons.text: A potion you drink also breathes its throw out round your feet, sparing you
boons.lore: Dr. Jelly tastes every brew and breathes the rest out in a long sigh. The laboratory's scorched floor shows where.

boons.name: Afterglow
boons.text: After a spell, your next three cantrip casts carry half its statuses
boons.lore: A spell leaves its light in the hand for a while after. A quick caster spends it before it fades.
